import json, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd() / "tools/qbe"))
from verify_public_int import run,digest
root=Path.cwd();build=root/"build/qbe-public-integration"
compiler=root/"build/qbe-port-tools/native-selfhost/frontend-stage3"
backend=root/"build/qbe-port-tools/native-selfhost/qbe-stage3"
baseline=build/"seed-front";old=Path.home()/".local/bin/lslc"
report={"scope":"Recheck known pre-existing public-language gaps; failures remain failures, not passes", "compiler_sha256":digest(compiler), "backend_sha256":digest(backend),"baseline_sha256":digest(baseline),"old_sha256":digest(old),"checks":[],"probe_finished":False}
path=build/"known-gaps.json"
cases=[root/"tests"/(name+"_conformance.lsl") for name in ("boxed_int_infrastructure","boxed_int_operations","automatic_gc")]+[build/"preexisting-float-gaps.lsl"]
for source in cases:
 expected=source.with_suffix(".out").read_text() if source.with_suffix(".out").exists() else "True\nTrue\nTrue\n"
 for kind,front in (("base_4f730f7",baseline),("integrated",compiler),("v089",old)):
  output=build/("known-"+source.stem+"-"+kind)
  cmd=[front,source,output]+([backend] if kind!="v089" else [])
  compiled=run(cmd,timeout=60);row={"source":str(source),"source_sha256":digest(source),"kind":kind,"expected":expected,"build":compiled}
  if compiled["returncode"]==0 and not compiled["timed_out"]:
   row["execution"]=run([output],timeout=30);row["matches_expected"]=row["execution"]["returncode"]==0 and row["execution"]["stdout"]==expected
  else: row["matches_expected"]=False
  row["status"]="PASS" if row["matches_expected"] else "FAIL"
  report["checks"].append(row);path.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+"\n");print(source.stem,kind,row["status"],flush=True)
report["probe_finished"]=True;path.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+"\n")
